name: FLIR Lepton 3.5 Thermal Camera Module
notes: Primary recommended thermal core. Export-controlled; international orders require an End Use Statement.

name: FLIR Lepton 2.5 Thermal Camera Module
notes: Optional budget alternative to Lepton 3.5 (excluded from required total). FLIR EOL notice (last buy Sept 2027); prefer Lepton 3.5.

name: FLIR Lepton Breakout Board V2.0
notes: Required carrier for Lepton 3.5/2.5. Do not substitute PureThermal USB UVC boards (they lack the 2x10 SPI header).

name: Teensy 4.1 Development Board
value_spec: ARM Cortex-M7 600MHz, 8MB Flash, microSD, w/o Headers
notes: Also stocked at Adafruit (ID 4622). V3.0 requires cutting the VUSB-VIN pad on the Teensy; V3.1 eliminates the pad cut via board-edge USB-C + D+/D- tap.

name: 3.2 Inch 240x320 TFT LCD Touch Display
value_spec: ILI9341 4-Wire SPI, 5V Supply, XPT2046 Resistive Touch
notes: Select exact options: Pin Header 4-Wire SPI, 5V Power Supply, 3.2-inch Resistive Touch Panel, No Font Chip. 2x20 2.54mm header pinout.

name: Pololu 5V Step-Up Voltage Regulator U3V16F5
notes: Boosts 3.7V Li-Ion cell to 5V for Teensy, Display, and Lepton. Stocked in EU via Botland/BerryBase.

name: Protected 3.7V 2000mAh Li-Ion/LiPo Pouch Battery
notes: Replaces obsolete Samsung EB-BG355BBE. Standard protected 2000mAh cell (60x36x7mm or 103450 50x34x10mm). Always verify JST-PH polarity before connecting.

name: Miniature Power Switch
notes: Solder wires horizontally to keep clearance inside enclosure (see issue #101).

name: Panel-Mount Momentary Pushbutton
notes: Primary RAFI switch matches V3.0 enclosure cutout; E-Switch PV5S640SS (12mm IP65) is an active industrial backup.

name: CR1220 3V Lithium Coin Cell
notes: Keeps real-time clock timestamps across power cycles.

name: 2x20 (40-Pin) Female Header Socket
notes: Mates with BuyDisplay ER-TFTM032-3. Any standard 2x20 2.54mm female socket (e.g. Raspberry Pi GPIO header) fits.

name: 2x10 (20-Pin) Female Header Socket
notes: Mates with FLIR Lepton Breakout Board V2.0.

name: 2.54mm Break-Away Male Pin Header Strip Pack
notes: Pack price ($4.95 for 360 pins). Used for Teensy 4.1, Booster, and jumper pins.

name: 2.54mm Female Header Strip Pack
notes: Pack price ($2.95 for 180 pins). Sockets Teensy 4.1 cleanly onto PCB.

name: 32GB Class 10 / U1 microSDHC Card
notes: Any 16GB-32GB Class 10 / U1 microSDHC formatted FAT32 works reliably with Teensy 4.1 SDIO.

name: 26 AWG Silicone Stranded Hook-Up Wire (Red)
notes: Pack price (2m). Short lengths needed for power switch, capture button, and V3.0 charger wiring.

name: 26 AWG Silicone Stranded Hook-Up Wire (Black)
notes: Pack price (2m). Ground/return wiring for switch and capture button.

name: Heat Shrink Tubing Assortment
notes: Keep sleeves short at button terminals to avoid mechanical strain against the display (issue #101).

name: DIY-Thermocam 2-Layer PCB
notes: Estimated per-board cost in qty 5 (excl. shipping/PCBA). Upload Gerber/KiCad fab package to JLCPCB, Seeed Fusion, or PCBWay.

name: DIY-Thermocam Enclosure
notes: Generated parametrically from hardware/enclosure/ (STEP, STL, laser-cut SVG). 3D-printed shell includes integrated lens hood/cap without webcam-cover vignetting.

name: M2.5 Enclosure Standoff & Screw Kit
notes: Full assortment pack ($16.95); individual ISO/DIN brass/steel hardware costs ~$4 locally. Use DIN 7991 countersunk screws for flush 3D-printed shell.

name: M2 Lepton & Display Fastener Set
value_spec: 4x M2x18 DIN 84, 4x M2x12 Spacer, 4x M2 Nylon Nut DIN 934, 3x M2x8 DIN 965, 3x M2 Nut+Washer
notes: Standard ISO/DIN M2 metric hardware available from any hardware supplier; estimated unit-build cost $4.00.

name: 1/4-20 UNC Tripod Mount Insert
value_spec: 1/4-20 Brass Heat-Set Insert (3D Print) OR Tee Nut (Acrylic)
notes: Use brass heat-set insert (93365A160) for 3D-printed shell or 1/4-20 tee nut (90973A029) for laser-cut acrylic.

name: TP4056 1A Li-Ion Charger Module w/ Protection
notes: V3.0 workaround for obsolete TP4057 (issue #103). Wire IN+/IN- to JP4/JP1 and OUT+/OUT- to LIPO/SWITCH; no power-path. Branded alt: Adafruit Micro-Lipo USB-C (ID 4410, $5.95, 500mA).

name: Bi-Color Charging Status LED (3mm/5mm THT)
notes: V3.0 external status LED wired to CHG-LED/LASER1 pads; leave 1-2mm lead standoff before bending 90 deg to align with enclosure hole (issues #93, #101).

name: CR1220 Coin Cell Holder (Through-Hole)
notes: Matches V3.0 Eagle/KiCad footprint BATTCON_12MM_PTH.

name: 4.7k Ohm 1% 1/4W Axial Resistor
notes: I2C pull-ups (R4, R6) and battery/VUSB voltage dividers (R1, R3).

name: 10k Ohm 1% 1/4W Axial Resistor
notes: Lower legs of battery (R2 -> D23) and VUSB (R5 -> A16) voltage dividers.

name: USB-A to Micro-B Data/Power Cable
notes: Must support USB data (not charge-only) for firmware flashing and USB v2 streaming.

name: TI BQ24075 Li-Ion Power-Path Charger IC
value_spec: 1.5A Dynamic Power-Path Single-Cell Li-Ion Charger, SYSOFF
notes: V3.1 turnkey PCBA charger. Powers system from USB while cleanly charging battery at ~890mA without load-sharing termination issues.

name: USB Type-C 16-Pin SMD Receptacle
value_spec: USB 2.0 Power + D+/D- Right-Angle Mid/Top Mount
notes: Board-edge USB-C port feeding BQ24075 IN and Teensy 4.1 D+/D- test pads (eliminates Teensy micro-USB alignment issues and VUSB cut).

name: USB 2.0 ESD Protection Diode Array
notes: Protects Teensy USB D+/D- lines at board-edge USB-C connector. JLCPCB Basic part.

name: JST-PH 2.0mm 2-Pin Battery Header
notes: Direct plug-in for Adafruit/SparkFun protected LiPo cells (verify polarity silkscreen +/-). Vertical alt: B2B-PH-K-S (C131337).

name: CR1220 Coin Cell Holder (SMD)
notes: SMD CR1220 retainer for single-sided V3.1 PCBA. DigiKey THT Keystone 3001 listed as hand-solder alt.

name: 4.7k Ohm 1% 0603 SMD Resistor
notes: I2C pull-ups (R4, R6) and battery/VBUS voltage dividers (R1, R3). JLCPCB Basic part.

name: 10k Ohm 1% 0603 SMD Resistor
notes: Voltage divider lower legs (R2, R5) + BQ24075 TS 10k fixed pull-down (R9). JLCPCB Basic part.

name: 5.1k Ohm 1% 0603 SMD Resistor
notes: Mandatory USB-C CC1 and CC2 sink pull-downs to request 5V from USB-C PD chargers. JLCPCB Basic part.

name: 1.0k Ohm 1% 0603 SMD Resistor
notes: BQ24075 R_ISET (~890mA charge), R_ILIM (~1.5A input limit), and CHG/PGOOD status LED current limiters. JLCPCB Basic part.

name: 1uF 50V X5R 0603 MLCC Capacitor
notes: BQ24075 IN pin input decoupling capacitor. JLCPCB Basic part.

name: 4.7uF 16V X5R 0603 MLCC Capacitor
notes: BQ24075 OUT and BAT pin decoupling capacitors. JLCPCB Basic part.

name: 10uF 25V X5R 0805 MLCC Capacitor
notes: 5V rail bulk decoupling near boost converter and Lepton header. JLCPCB Basic part.

name: Red 0603 SMD Status LED
notes: Driven by BQ24075 open-drain ~CHG pin (lit while charging). JLCPCB Basic part.

name: Green 0603 SMD Status LED
notes: Driven by BQ24075 open-drain ~PGOOD pin (lit when USB power is valid). JLCPCB Basic part.

name: USB-A to USB-C Data/Power Cable
notes: Single USB-C cable handles charging, live streaming, and Teensy firmware updates on V3.1.
